title: The fixes for the security review's findings pass CI on main
claim: Fixes for findings 1 to 7 and 10 of the security review (pull request 45) passed CI on main in the run for commit 67b49b6; each of the review's tests that was an expected failure is now an ordinary passing test. Findings 8 and P39-1 were fixed with the rate limits in pull request 39. Findings 9, 11, 12, 13 and the notes are open, and the review itself lists what it did not read
